name: surugaya-japan-hobby-prices
description: Scrape used & new prices from Suruga-ya (駿河屋), Japan's largest second-hand collectibles store. Extract 24 data fields including name, used/new/list price, brand, release date, stock status, images, condition badges. Unique fields: original list price (定価), brand/publisher, and release date — not available in competing scrapers. Supports Japanese keyword search, batch multi-keyword input, stock filtering, and Cloudflare bypass with Playwright fallback.
author: Atushi
